low.solver_intent: fewest bounded iterations, loose residual epsilon, stable voltage field over visual exactness

middle.solver_intent: moderate iterations, tighter epsilon, stable brownout propagation

high.solver_intent: higher iteration budget, sharper loop equalization

ultra.solver_intent: maximum bounded iterations and strict epsilon, spend saved cycles on visible voltage fidelity

telemetry_gap.implemented_state: solver telemetry counter records active cap, completed iterations, residual epsilon bits, residual bits, cap flag, and divergence flag; PowerGrid scratch thermal/battery buffers now use DataVault generation handles
